old_problem: The historical record elevated target-specific SMM/switch identity, USB route, interface manifest and thresholds to an Engineering Decision although the read-only enumeration purpose, safe method and recovery boundary were defined.
disposition_reason: ED-03, ED-07, ED-08, ED-09, ED-15 and ED-20 allow the project-specific controller identity and topology oracle to be runtime prerequisites. Full path-bound USB descriptors, bindings and health logs safely test detection without resetting or reconfiguring the management controller. Missing bindings block execution, not the review design.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2174, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; row 2175 was directly read as outside the pending queue and actual next formal row Functionality 2176 / Wistron-BIOS-00493-V004 / d6488d88b76dc9d3 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Bind SMM and Ethernet-switch PN/revision/instance and the CPU root-port/connector/hub-or-mux route.
Freeze stable controller VID:PID/product/serial/configuration/interfaces, drivers and negotiated speed; composite functions require every listed interface.
Operator proves the internal physical route; authenticated host automation collects complete unfiltered USB and health evidence.
Detection is path-and-identity match; an optional functional query must be separately approved, read-only and non-disruptive.
Generic hub substitution, insecure/truncated output, reset/deauthorize/rebind/mode or firmware change and automatic retry are prohibited.
No USB query, physical manipulation, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized CPU-to-SMM Ethernet-switch USB controller detection validation
test_case.purpose: Verify that the intended SMM Ethernet-switch USB management controller enumerates through the signed CPU route with every required interface, driver and speed while switch manageability remains stable.
required_package: SMM/Ethernet-switch PN, revision and instance identity
Operator route evidence, health/error thresholds and recovery
test_case.test_command: After operator confirms the internal path, collect complete `lsusb -t`, full descriptors and driver bindings for the exact SMM Ethernet-switch USB controller and every required interface; correlate negotiated speed with CPU, SMM, switch, kernel and USB health/reset logs. Run only a separately approved read-only controller identity/status query, if specified, and leave binding and management state unchanged.
test_case.expected_result: The exact signed controller and all required interfaces appear only on the approved CPU-to-SMM route with matching descriptors, drivers and speed; optional approved status matches the oracle, and no reset, flap, degradation or unexpected health error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when identity, route, every required interface, binding, speed and signed health thresholds match. Wrong/unrelated device, missing interface, misbinding, downgrade outside the oracle or management/USB health breach is FAIL. Missing runtime identity, topology, manifest or threshold is BLOCKED, not assumed PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until SMM/switch identity, route, manifest, limits, authorization and recovery are signed.
Confirm this path is not being used for an active recovery operation before optional query.
Read-only collection only; no reset, deauthorize, unbind/rebind, mode switch, firmware/update, power action, log clearing or automatic retry.
Stop on identity ambiguity, switch-management degradation, driver churn, reset storm, downgrade or flapping.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and signed SMM/switch/controller bindings
Operator photos and CPU-to-SMM route map
Complete tree, device/configuration/interface descriptors, driver bindings and speed
Manifest comparison and optional approved read-only status
Pre/post SMM/switch/kernel/USB health and reset/error evidence
Unchanged management state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on mismatch or instability. Leave the USB controller bound and switch management state unchanged; use only the signed out-of-band recovery path, without reset, rebind, firmware action, power cycle or retry.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target the CPU-connected Ethernet-switch USB controller on SMM; generic BMC/HPM wording is a DeepSeek defect.

blocked.reason: The detection purpose and safe read-only method are clear; target-specific identities and limits are runtime configuration.
